metaDescription: Kevin promotes theaicults.com, his site on the seven transhumanist-linked cults he says Silicon Valley billionaires belong to.
summary: Kevin promotes theaicults.com, a website he built to expose what he calls seven interlinked cults among Silicon Valley billionaires. He argues these groups believe most people will die and that humanity will merge with AI, and that the billionaires are planning for and hastening this outcome. Kevin says this explains the state of the world and urges viewers to visit the site and learn about it.
